title: From Unity Simulation to Diffusion-Based Augmentation: Quantifying Dataset Balance for Robust Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.38010v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern computer vision models achieve high accuracy when trained on large-scale annotated datasets. In critical domains such as construction safety monitoring, data collection is costly, hazardous, and ethically constrained. This paper presents a systematic study comparing two complementary data generation paradigms, (1) Unity Simulation-based rendering and (2) Controllable Diffusion-based generation (CIA), for object detection under real data-scarce conditions. A unified experimental framework enables controlled dataset mixing across real, simulated, and generative sources, while maintaining identical model and training settings. Quantitative evaluation using Precision, Recall, mAP, and custom $\Delta$-metrics, reveals that neither simulation nor generative augmentation alone achieves optimal transferability. translated_title: 从Unity仿真到基于扩散模型的增强：量化数据集平衡以实现鲁棒目标检测
translated_abstract: 现代计算机视觉模型在大规模标注数据集上训练时能够达到很高的精度。然而在建筑施工安全监控等关键领域，数据采集成本高昂、过程危险且受到伦理限制。本文提出了一项系统性研究，比较两种互补的数据生成范式——(1)基于Unity仿真的渲染和(2)可控扩散模型生成（CIA）——在真实数据稀缺条件下的目标检测性能。该统一实验框架支持对来自真实、仿真和生成来源的数据进行可控混合，同时保持模型与训练设置完全一致。基于精确率、召回率、mAP以及自定义Δ指标的定量评估表明，无论是仿真还是生成式增强，单独使用均无法实现最优的迁移能力：仅使用Unity数据训练时，mAP@0.5相对真实数据下降50%；而仅使用CIA数据训练时，下降幅度较为温和，为16.5%。
tldr: 论文系统比较了Unity仿真渲染与可控扩散模型生成（CIA）两种数据生成范式在数据稀缺场景下对目标检测的增强效果，通过统一的数据混合实验框架和自定义Δ指标量化分析，发现两者单独使用均无法达到最优迁移性能，揭示了合理配置真实、仿真与生成数据比例对构建鲁棒检测模型的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares Unity simulation rendering and controllable diffusion-based generation (CIA) for object detection under data scarcity, showing through a unified dataset-mixing framework and custom Δ-metrics that neither paradigm alone achieves optimal transferability, thus quantifying the importance of balancing real, simulated, and generated data for robust detection.
